summary: The notes capture recent Iceberg‑Spark integration work, highlighting new features such as DSv2 column ID support, geometry bounds emission, and runtime filtering, along with several bug fixes for Parquet, ORC, and vectorized reads. The thread discusses adding a batch signing endpoint to the REST catalog spec to support the new FILE type where each row may reference an external object. Participants highlight the need to include authorization context per element, potentially altering the request design to accommodate file reference permissions. The community largely agrees, suggesting a refactor-first approach that deprecates Jackson‑typed APIs before adding Jackson 3 support, and recommends splitting the work into several PRs.
